title: Python AI/ML Faculty
description:
**Job Title:** Python AI/ML Faculty

**Company:** Promise Academy  
**Location:** Naranpura, Ahmedabad, Gujarat  
**Job Type:** Full-Time, Permanent  
**Work Mode:** On-site  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years Preferred  
**Salary:** ₹15,000–₹30,000 per month, based on skills and experience

**Job Description**

* Promise Academy is looking for an experienced and passionate **Python AI/ML Faculty Member** to train students in Python Programming, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Data Science.
* We are specifically looking for candidates with **prior teaching or faculty experience in a computer training institute, coaching academy, college, or educational institution.**
* The ideal candidate should have strong technical knowledge, excellent communication skills, classroom management abilities, and experience teaching students through lectures, practical sessions, and live projects.
* **Important: This is a teaching position, not a software development or IT developer role.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Teach Python Programming from basic to advanced levels.
* Conduct classroom lectures and hands-on practical training in Python, AI, ML, and Data Science.
* Explain programming concepts, algorithms, and technical topics in a simple, student-friendly manner.
* Prepare lesson plans, presentations, assignments, and assessments.
* Guide students through academic projects and practical assignments.
* Evaluate student progress and provide individual mentoring.
* Resolve students' technical doubts during classroom and lab sessions.
* Update teaching materials according to current industry trends.

**Required Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Python Programming and Object-Oriented Programming.
* Knowledge of NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, and Scikit-learn.
* Understanding of Machine Learning algorithms and basic statistics.
* Knowledge of Deep Learning, TensorFlow, or PyTorch is preferred.
* Familiarity with SQL, Data Analysis, and Data Visualization.
* Good presentation, communication, and student-handling skills.

**Eligibility Criteria**

* **Prior teaching or faculty experience is strongly preferred.**
* Candidates who have worked as Python Faculty, AI/ML Trainer, Programming Instructor, Computer Faculty, or Technical Trainer are encouraged to apply.
* Experience teaching students in an institute, academy, college, or training centre is desirable.
* Candidates must be comfortable conducting regular classroom and practical sessions.
* B.E./B.Tech, M.E./M.Tech, MCA, M.Sc. IT, M.Sc. Computer Science, or an equivalent qualification in a relevant field is preferred.

**Who Should Apply?**

* Experienced Python Faculty Members.
* AI/ML Trainers with classroom teaching experience.
* Programming Instructors from computer training institutes.
* Computer Science Faculty Members with strong Python and AI/ML knowledge.

**Please note:** Candidates with only software development or IT industry experience and no teaching or student-training experience are not the target candidates for this position.

**Work Location**

Promise Academy  
309–310, Shanti Arcade, Opp. Jay Mangal BRTS Bus Stop,  
132 Ft Ring Road, Naranpura, Ahmedabad – 380013.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates should apply through Indeed with an updated resume highlighting their teaching experience, subjects taught, previous institute or college, and relevant technical skills.

Please mention your teaching experience and the subjects you have taught in your application.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Sr. Data Scientist
description:
​We are seeking a skilled Data Scientist with 4-7 years of experience who is passionate about solving complex problems using data and AI. The ideal candidate will have expertise in Python, NLP, Generative AI, and a strong grasp of working with databases and search engines like MongoDB, Solr, and Redis. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, build, and implement data-driven solutions that enhance our HR technology products.

​**Key Responsibilities**

* Data Analysis & Modeling
* Extract, clean, and analyze large datasets to derive actionable insights.
* Develop predictive models, algorithms, and machine learning solutions to solve business problems.
* Natural Language Processing (NLP)
* Work on text processing, sentiment analysis, entity recognition, and text classification.
* Build and fine-tune language models using tools like Hugging Face Transformers, OpenAI APIs, or similar frameworks.
* Generative AI & LLMs
* Develop and deploy solutions using large language models (LLMs) for tasks such as text generation, summarization, and conversational AI.
* Experiment with state-of-the-art generative AI technologies to enhance product capabilities.
* Database & Search Optimization
* Manage and optimize NoSQL databases such as MongoDB for high performance.
* Work with Solr and Redis to develop and maintain search functionality and caching mechanisms.
* API Development & Integration
* Design and develop RESTful APIs to integrate machine learning solutions into existing systems.
* Collaborate with backend engineers for seamless system integration.
* Research & Innovation
* Stay updated on the latest advancements in AI, NLP, and machine learning.
* Propose innovative solutions and conduct research to improve the performance of existing systems.

**Qualifications & Skills**

**Mandatory:**

* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.
* 4-7 years of relevant experience in data science and machine learning.
* Proficiency in Python and its libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch).
* Experience with NLP tools and frameworks like NLTK, SpaCy, or Hugging Face.
* Hands-on experience with large language models (LLMs) and Generative AI tools.
* Strong knowledge of MongoDB, Solr, and Redis.
* Proficient in designing and developing RESTful APIs.
* Solid understanding of machine learning algorithms and statistical analysis.

**Preferred:**

* Experience in the HR tech industry.
* Knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker, or cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Familiarity with DevOps tools and practices.
* Contributions to open-source NLP/AI projects are a plus.

Pay: ₹840,000.00 - ₹1,800,000.00 per year

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380009: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Application Question(s):

* Current CTC (yearly)
* Expected CTC (yearly)
* Notice Period or Last Working Date
* Reason for Job Change
* Are you from Ahmedabad or ready to relocate to Ahmedabad?

Experience:

* Python: 5 years (Required)

title: AI/ML Lead
